chars.NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man about 19, black hoodie with white drawstrings, red baseball cap worn backwards, baggy light grey jeans, white sneakers
chars.STUDIOGUY: a Moroccan man about 28 with a thick black beard, olive green bomber jacket, black beanie, big black headphones around his neck

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Narrow Moroccan neighborhood alley (derb) with painted walls. NARRATOR walks past STUDIOGUY who leans by a doorway; NARRATOR glances at him sideways, nervous, half-raising a hand to greet but freezing, awkward comic face. Seen from a nearby doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: STUDIOGUY standing confidently in a Moroccan alley, chatting and laughing with two blurry neighborhood boys in the background, cool and respected, head-to-waist framing, face visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR at the corner of a Moroccan alley, peeking around the wall, taking a deep breath to gather courage, fists clenched, comic determined expression, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR walking quickly past STUDIOGUY in the alley again, eyes down, pretending to look at his phone, STUDIOGUY looks at him puzzled. Funny awkward moment, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR finally stops in front of STUDIOGUY and offers a handshake with a big nervous smile, STUDIOGUY shakes his hand, surprised. Moroccan alley, warm afternoon light, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: STUDIOGUY smiling and pointing up toward a rooftop with a small home studio, inviting gesture; NARRATOR beams with joy, mouth open in disbelief. Moroccan alley, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR lying on a bed in a modest Moroccan bedroom at night, staring at the ceiling with a huge happy grin, headphones on, posters on the wall.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR laughing too hard at STUDIOGUY's joke on a Moroccan rooftop studio with a microphone and a laptop, flattering him, STUDIOGUY telling the joke proudly. Comic, both faces visible.
